gloss: to joke; to crack a joke

definitions.gloss: to joke; to crack a joke; to say something humorous
definitions.explanation: To make a humorous remark or tell a joke. Can also be used sarcastically when someone says something absurd or unbelievable.

examples.japanese: {冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}って⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和|なご}ませた→和む：18058_nagomu⟧。
examples.english: I cracked a joke to lighten the mood.

examples.japanese: {冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{本気|ほんき}→本気：03153_honki⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I can't tell if he's joking or being serious.

examples.japanese: {冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}う⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめて⟦くれ→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{真剣|しんけん}→真剣：01565_shinken⟧な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧んだ。
examples.english: Stop joking around. We're having a serious discussion right now.

notes:
The standard expression for "to tell a joke" or "to joke around." ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧ means "joke" and ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ means "to say." The combination is extremely common in daily conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}う — to joke, to crack a joke
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧ — that's no joke; I'm serious (used to deny joking)
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧でしょう？ — you're joking, right? (disbelief)
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よせ→よす：02328_yosu⟧ — cut it out with the jokes
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|つう}じない→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ — a person who can't take a joke

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ふざける→ふざける：09309_fuzakeru⟧ — to joke around, to fool around (less about telling jokes, more about playful behavior)
- ⟦からかう→からかう：07353_karakau⟧ — to tease, to make fun of (directed at a specific person)
- ⟦おどける→おどける：16198_odokeru⟧ — to clown around, to act funny (physical humor)

USAGE:
{冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧ ("this is no time for jokes") is a set phrase used to express urgency or seriousness. ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧でしょう is commonly used to express disbelief, similar to English "You must be kidding."
